lessons.title: Where is the... ?

items.exampleMeaning: The store is on the corner.

lessons.tip: Use 'Var är...' to ask for the location of something. Remember to use the definite article when you refer to specific places, like 'biblioteket'.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: The store is on the corner.

scenario.partnerRole: You are a local who knows the area well.
scenario.learnerRole: You are a tourist asking for directions.
scenario.brief: Fråga om var affären, sjukhuset och parken ligger. Ge tydliga svar.
scenario.goal: You need to ask for directions to three different places.

lessons.title: Giving Directions

items.exampleMeaning: The hospital is behind the park.
The school is next to the store.

lessons.tip: When giving directions, use the imperative form of the verb. For example, 'Gå till...' means 'Go to...'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: How do I get to the hospital?

scenario.partnerRole: You are a local who is giving directions.
scenario.learnerRole: You are a tourist asking for directions.
scenario.brief: Fråga hur man kommer till sjukhuset. Få instruktioner om att gå till skolan och svänga vänster.
scenario.goal: You need to understand the directions given to you.

lessons.title: More Places

items.exampleMeaning: The café is located by the park.
The cinema is next to the restaurant.

lessons.tip: Remember to use the definite article when you refer to specific places. For example, 'restaurangen' means 'the restaurant'.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Yes, the café is located by the park.

scenario.partnerRole: You are a local who knows the area.
scenario.learnerRole: You are a tourist wanting to know about places.
scenario.brief: Fråga om restaurangen och kaféet. Få information om stationen.
scenario.goal: You need to find out about three different places.

lessons.title: Finding Your Way

items.exampleMeaning: The cinema is in front of the store.

items.example: Restaurangen är i närheten av torget.
items.exampleMeaning: The restaurant is near the square.

lessons.tip: Use 'till vänster' and 'till höger' to give directions. These phrases help indicate the direction someone should take.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Nej, den är i närheten av affären.
dialogue.meaning: No, it is near the store.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Gå till vänster och sväng till höger.
dialogue.meaning: Go to the left and turn to the right.

scenario.partnerRole: You are a local giving directions.
scenario.learnerRole: You are a tourist trying to find the cinema.
scenario.brief: Fråga om biografens läge. Få anvisningar om hur man kommer dit.
scenario.goal: You need to find the cinema.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: The store is on the corner.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: How do I get to the museum?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Gå rakt fram och sväng vänster.
dialogue.meaning: Go straight ahead and turn left.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Nej, kaféet är i närheten av torget.
dialogue.meaning: No, the café is near the square.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: The hospital is behind the school.

scenario.partnerRole: You are a local who knows the area.
scenario.learnerRole: You are a tourist asking for directions.
scenario.brief: Fråga om olika platser som affären, museet och kaféet. Få tydliga svar.
scenario.goal: You need to ask for and understand directions to various places.
